why: The original 1856 Kellogg/Blanchard print depicts the completed ca. 1836–1849 Lake House, not this ticket's July 1835 construction state. All additional known source-page images were inspected: the about 1860 photograph and 1869 map are later completed states; the 1857 ad and 1856 ad/1854 menu contain no architecture. No eligible July construction picture is known in these named sources. The active project is supported by the June 10, 1835 notice and now visibly built as declared reconstruction. Final pinned native, global and published desktop/phone evidence and the dated wrong-state ruling are recorded in the ticket body. This uses the existing wrong-picture exception and claims no source-camera geometric matches verdict.
